strongest_counterexample: Cloth convergence could leave a smooth bodysuit and destroy partial-pose support; welded headwear could remain an oversized helmet; unchanged eye/beard design could still fail the film-quality floor. All remain vetoes. This admits the local cloth method test, not the artistic result. Startup recovery may expose a different native solver failure; it will not authorize additional uncounted retries.
